info.name: RideApp — Financial Flows Deep Dive
info.description:
Full coverage of every financial flow found in the codebase:

💡 HOW YOUR PAYMENT SYSTEM WORKS (from the code):

1. PAYMENT LIFECYCLE:
   Created → Authorized (funds in escrow) → Settled (escrow → driver + platform) OR Refunded (escrow → rider)

2. DUAL WALLET SYSTEM:
   • wallets table: simple balance/locked_balance (fast reads)
   • ledger_accounts + ledger_entries: double-entry accounting (audit trail)
   Both exist in parallel.

3. PAYMENT STRATEGIES:
   • wallet: deduct wallet balance → escrow
   • gateway: eSewa/Khalti external gateway → escrow
   • gift: GiftCard balance → escrow
   • bnpl: BNPL credit account → escrow (stub, not fully implemented)
   • points: FinancialPoints → escrow (FIFO batch expiry at 2 months)

4. PAYMENT HOLDS (PaymentHoldService):
   Pre-ride hold on wallet locked_balance → capture on ride complete → release on cancel

5. LEDGER PLATFORM ACCOUNTS (auto-init on server start):
   escrow | revenue | clearing | bnpl | gift | payout_holding

6. SETTLEMENT FLOW:
   Ride complete → LedgerService.settlePayment → Escrow splits to DriverWallet + PlatformRevenue
   → Settlement record created (pending) → Driver requests payout → Admin approves → Batch created
   → LedgerService.processPayout (DriverWallet → payout_holding)
   → LedgerService.releasePayoutToClearing (payout_holding → clearing)

7. REFUND FLOW:
   Ride cancel → LedgerService.refundPayment → Escrow back to original source (wallet/gift/bnpl)
   Gateway refunds: stub only (TODO in code)

8. POINTS:
   1 NPR = 3.33 points earned | 1 point = 0.30 NPR redeemed
   FIFO batch expiry: 2 months per batch

9. GIFT CARDS:
   Purchase (wallet debit) → code generated → redeem to wallet (credit) or use at ride payment
   Transfer between users supported

10. BNPL:
   Strategy stub exists. BNPLAccount model exists. Platform 'bnpl' ledger account exists.
   Full credit scoring / repayment logic not yet implemented in code.

⚠️  MISSING ROUTES (logic exists in services but no HTTP routes yet):
   - POST /api/payments/authorize (authorizeRidePayment)
   - POST /api/payments/capture (capturePayment)
   - POST /api/payments/refund/:rideId
   - GET  /api/settlements/:settlementId
   - POST /api/settlements/:settlementId/complete
   - POST /api/points/earn
   - GET  /api/points/balance
   - POST /api/points/redeem
   - POST /api/payments/holds (createHold)
   - POST /api/payments/holds/:holdId/capture
   - POST /api/payments/holds/:holdId/release
   These are tested via internal service calls (ride completion auto-triggers them).
   You should add these routes to expose them.

IMPORT INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Import this collection AND the main collection
2. They share the same variables (baseUrl, riderToken, etc.)
3. Run Auth section first to get tokens
4. Then run each section top-to-bottom — they chain IDs automatically

exec: if (j.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('driverToken', j.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('driverId', j.driverId || j.userId); }

item.name: 🔒 PAYMENT HOLDS
item.description:
PaymentHoldService: Pre-ride fund reservation. On ride accept, hold is created locking funds. On ride complete → capture. On ride cancel → release.

⚠️ NOTE: Holds are created internally by the ride lifecycle (acceptRide → createHold). These requests test the service layer directly IF you wire up the routes. Currently no HTTP routes expose holds directly.

exec: console.log('Before hold — Balance:', d.balance, '| Locked:', d.lockedBalance, '| Available:', d.availableBalance, '| Active holds:', d.activeHolds);

item.name: [Simulated] Accept Ride → Auto-Creates Hold
item.description:
Accepting a ride via the ride lifecycle internally calls PaymentHoldService.createHold. This triggers:
  1. Wallet locked_balance += amount
  2. PaymentHold record created (status=active)
  3. Hold expires in 24h if not captured

Run: POST /api/rides/accept/:requestId to trigger this.

exec: console.log('After hold — Balance:', d.balance, '| Locked:', d.lockedBalance, '| Available:', d.availableBalance, '| Active holds:', d.activeHolds, '| Total locked amount:', d.totalLockedAmount);

item.name: [Simulated] Complete Ride → Captures Hold
item.description:
Completing ride calls PaymentHoldService.captureHold:
  1. Wallet balance -= captureAmount
  2. Wallet locked_balance -= holdAmount
  3. Hold status = captured
  4. Then LedgerService.settlePayment runs (Escrow → Driver + Platform)

item.name: [Simulated] Cancel Ride → Releases Hold (REFUND)
item.description:
Cancelling ride calls PaymentHoldService.releaseHold:
  1. Wallet locked_balance -= holdAmount
  2. Hold status = released
  3. Then LedgerService.refundPayment runs (Escrow → Rider)
  4. RidePayment.payment_status = refunded

item.name: 📊 LEDGER — Double Entry Accounting
item.description:
LedgerService uses double-entry bookkeeping.
Every financial event creates a ledger entry: debit one account, credit another.
Platform accounts: escrow | revenue | clearing | bnpl | gift | payout_holding

exec: console.log('Ledger accountId:', j.accountId, '| Balance:', j.balance, j.currency);
console.log('Latest entry — type:', e.entry_type, '| amount:', e.amount, '| ref:', e.reference_type, '| id:', e.reference_id);
console.log('Settlements:', settlements.length, '| Commissions:', commissions.length, '| Payouts:', payouts.length);

item.name: 🔁 REFUNDS — All Scenarios
item.description:
Refund flows in the codebase:

1. WALLET refund: Escrow → Rider wallet (LedgerService.refundPayment)
2. GIFT refund: Escrow → Platform gift account
3. BNPL refund: Escrow → Platform bnpl account
4. GATEWAY refund: Stub only (TODO in GatewayStrategy.refund)
5. CASH: No refund needed (no escrow hold)

All refunds triggered by cancelRidePayment. Idempotency: cannot refund already-settled payments.

item.name: 1. Cancel Ride Payment (triggers refund to wallet)

exec: console.log('✅ Refund processed. Payment status now: refunded');
if (j.message === 'CANNOT_REFUND_SETTLED_PAYMENT') console.warn('Cannot refund — ride already settled/completed.');
if (j.message === 'INVALID_PAYMENT_STATE') console.warn('Payment is not in authorized state.');

item.name: 3. Check Wallet Balance After Refund (should be restored)

exec: console.log('Post-refund balance:', d.balance, '| Locked:', d.lockedBalance, '| Available:', d.availableBalance);
if (refunds.length) console.log('Latest refund:', refunds[0].amount, refunds[0].entry_type, refunds[0].description);
console.log('Payment status:', d.payment_status, '| Refund reason:', d.refund_reason, '| Refunded at:', d.refunded_at);

item.name: 🏦 SETTLEMENT FLOW
item.description:
After ride completes:
  1. LedgerService.settlePayment → Escrow split to Driver + Platform
  2. Settlement record created (status=pending)
  3. Driver requests payout → PayoutService.requestPayout
  4. Admin approves → PayoutService.approvePayoutRequest
  5. Batch created → PayoutService.createPayoutBatch
  6. LedgerService.processPayout → DriverWallet → payout_holding
  7. LedgerService.releasePayoutToClearing → payout_holding → clearing

item.name: 1. Get Ride Payment Details (should be settled after ride complete)

if (j.data && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('payoutRequestId', j.data.id); console.log('✅ payoutRequestId:', j.data.id); }
console.log('Pending payouts:', j.data.length, '| First ID:', j.data[0].id, '| Amount:', j.data[0].amount);
if (j && j.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('payoutBatchId', j.id); console.log('✅ Batch created:', j.id, '| Total:', j.total_amount); }

item.name: 🏆 FINANCIAL POINTS (1 point = Rs.0.30)
item.description:
FinancialPointsService:
• Earn: 10/3 points per NPR (configurable via POINTS_CONVERSION constant)
• Redeem: 1 point = NPR 0.30 (NPR_PER_POINT)
• FIFO batch expiry: each batch expires 2 months from earn date
• Points payment source: 'points' — auto-redeems FIFO during ride payment

⚠️ NOTE: No HTTP routes exist for points yet. These are placeholder requests for when you add them.
Suggested routes to implement:
  POST /api/points/earn
  GET  /api/points/balance
  POST /api/points/redeem
  POST /api/points/expire (cron trigger)

Currently points are used internally when paymentSource = 'points' in authorizePayment.

item.name: 🏦 BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later)
item.description:
BNPL in your codebase:
• BNPLStrategy exists (strategy pattern) — authorize/capture/refund stubs
• BNPLAccount model exists in DB
• Platform 'bnpl' ledger account exists
• LedgerService supports paymentSource='bnpl' (uses platform bnpl account as source)

⚠️ WHAT'S NOT IMPLEMENTED YET:
  - Credit scoring / eligibility check
  - Repayment schedule creation
  - Repayment collection
  - BNPL account limit management
  - Overdue/late fee handling
  - HTTP routes for BNPL management

🔧 WHAT EXISTS (internal only):
  - BNPLStrategy.authorize() — returns {authorized:true} (stub)
  - BNPLStrategy.capture() — returns {captured:true} (stub)
  - BNPLStrategy.refund() — returns {refunded:true} (stub)
  - LedgerService handles 'bnpl' source by using platform bnpl account

BNPL Ledger flow:
  Authorize: platform_bnpl → escrow
  Settle: escrow → driver + platform
  Refund: escrow → platform_bnpl

item.name: 🎴 GIFT CARDS — Full Flow
item.description:
Gift cards use TWO payment strategies:
  1. GiftStrategy: use gift card as payment for ride
  2. GiftCardService.redeemToWallet: convert gift card balance to wallet

Ledger flow on gift card ride payment:
  platform_gift_account → escrow (authorization)
  escrow → driver + platform (settlement)
  escrow → platform_gift_account (refund if cancelled)
